map.输入转速、转动惯量、制动时间，计算所需制动力矩与制动功率: Enter speed, moment of inertia and braking time to compute the required brake torque and braking power.
map.制动力矩计算：基于转速、转动惯量与制动时间，按角加速度需求计算所需制动力矩并乘安: Brake torque calculation: based on speed, moment of inertia and braking time, compute the required brake torque by angular-acceleration demand and multiply by safety factor, for brake selection.
map.💡 T=J×ω/t=(J×2π×n)/(60×t)；制动功率=P=T×ω/100: Formula: T=J times omega/t=(J times 2pi times n)/(60 times t); braking power=P=T times omega/1000.
map.制动时间过短会导致制动力矩急剧增大，需校核制动器容量: Too short a braking time sharply increases brake torque; check brake capacity.
map.提升负载制动时需考虑重力反向力矩，取更大安全系数: Lifting-load braking must consider the gravity reverse torque; use a larger safety factor.
map.频繁制动需校核制动器的热容量和磨损: Frequent braking must check the brake heat capacity and wear.

map.热负荷评估：算峰值功率与制动能量，判断制动器容量: Thermal-load assessment: compute peak power and braking energy to judge brake capacity.
map.工况比选：按负载类型（惯性/阻力辅助/提升负载）调整力矩: Condition comparison: adjust torque by load type (inertia/resistance-assist/lifting).
map.ω = 2π×n/60（rad/s）；角减速度 = ω/制动时间；制动力矩 =: omega = 2pi times n/60 (rad/s); angular deceleration = omega / braking time; brake torque = moment of inertia J times angular deceleration times load factor; selection torque = brake torque times safety factor; peak power = brake torque times omega / 1000 (kW); average power = peak / 2; braking energy = 0.5 times J times omega^2/1000 (kJ). Assessment: t<1 s extremely short, large brake needed; <3 s fast, mind thermal load; <10 s moderate; else slow, can reduce size.
map.例：n=1450rpm、J=2.5kg·m²、t=3s、SF=1.5、负载系数: Example: n=1450 rpm, J=2.5 kg m2, t=3 s, SF=1.5, load factor 0.8 (resistance assist) -> omega 151.84 rad/s, deceleration 50.61 rad/s2, brake torque 101.23 N m, selection torque 151.84 N m, peak power 15.37 kW, average 7.69 kW, braking energy 28.82 kJ, hint: moderate braking. If n=2900 rpm, J=1.2 kg m2, t=1 s, load factor 1.0 -> omega 303.69 rad/s, brake torque 364.42 N m, selection torque 546.64 N m, peak power 110.67 kW, braking energy 55.34 kJ, hint: fast braking, mind thermal load.
map.它反映制动时除惯性力矩外是否还有其他力矩参与：选纯惯性制动取 1.0；若有摩擦阻: It reflects whether, besides inertial torque, other torque participates in braking: pure inertia takes 1.0; if friction resistance helps braking (resistance assist) take <1; if it is a lifting load lowering (potential energy drives back) take >1. This tool uses it as a direct multiplier on brake torque; judge the actual condition before setting.
map.峰值功率和平均功率为什么差一倍？: Why is peak power double the average power?
map.匀减速制动时， braking 功率 = 制动力矩×瞬时角速度，角速度从 ω 线: Under uniform deceleration, braking power = brake torque times instantaneous angular speed; as angular speed drops linearly from omega to 0, power also drops linearly, so the average is exactly half the peak. In selection, check the brake heat capacity by average power and its mechanical capacity by peak torque; do not mix them.
map.制动力矩计算器根据转速、转动惯量和制动时间，计算所需制动力矩、峰值功率和制动能量: The brake torque calculator, by speed, moment of inertia and braking time, computes the required brake torque, peak power and braking energy, supporting three conditions (pure inertia, resistance assist, reverse lifting load) for brake selection data.
